traditional: 令 A 同 B 撞埋一齊
jyutping: ling6 A tung4 B zong6 maai4 jat1 cai4

english.note: Use this causative construction when someone or something makes two things collide.

examples.english: The roadblock causes the two cars and a truck to collide.
examples.traditional: 個路障令兩架車同一架貨車撞埋一齊。
examples.jyutping: go3 lou6 zoeng3 ling6 loeng5 gaa3 ce1 tung4 jat1 gaa3 fo3 ce1 zong6 maai4 jat1 cai4
